name: Message to Freewind Post
summary: At Thousand Needles' western approaches, Brave Moonhorn sends an urgent warning to Freewind Post. Centaur raids are rising, and he reports strange behavior among the Grimtotem.

sections.title: A Warning Down the Canyon
sections.body: Brave Moonhorn watches Thousand Needles' western approaches. Centaur attacks have risen sharply, and the border sentries need to alert their leaders. So Moonhorn asks you to carry a dispatch southeast to Cliffwatcher Longhorn, commander of the mesa settlement at Freewind Post.

sections.title: Rising Perils and Uneasy Kin
sections.body: Cliffwatcher Longhorn confirms that centaur recently intercepted and slaughtered a supply caravan. Freewind Post must defend itself and answer the attack. Moonhorn also warns you to avoid the nearby Grimtotem tauren. Their strange, hostile behavior points to growing divisions across the arid flats.

faq.q: Who sends the message to Freewind Post?
aliases: who starts message to freewind post
faq.answer: Brave Moonhorn, a tauren scout, watches Thousand Needles' western entrance and gives you the urgent message to deliver.
Cliffwatcher Longhorn receives the message at Freewind Post, the mesa settlement southeast of the Great Lift.

faq.q: What does the urgent message report?
faq.answer: The message warns that centaur attacks and harassment of caravans along the trails below have risen sharply.

faq.q: Why is Brave Moonhorn worried about the Grimtotem?
faq.answer: Moonhorn says the nearby Grimtotem have acted strangely and kept their distance from other tauren. He advises you to avoid them.

faq.q: What happens after Longhorn reads the message?
faq.answer: After learning that centaur slaughtered a supply caravan, Cliffwatcher Longhorn orders a counterattack against them in the follow-up, Pacify the Centaur.

faq.q: How do you reach Freewind Post from the canyon floor?
aliases: how to get up freewind post
faq.answer: From the canyon floor, follow the main road east to the base of the needle mesa. Then take the wooden platform lift up to the village.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the centaur as bitter ancestral rivals. Moonhorn's warning shows they still hunt Kalimdor's trails, while tensions with the reclusive Grimtotem simmer.
As a member of the Horde, you know Freewind Post links the routes across Thousand Needles. Open communication between the outpost watchers and settlement leaders helps secure the desert trade routes.
